fixture_disclosure: All incident data shown in the campaign is a deterministic product fixture, not a customer incident.

evidence_contract.resolution: Open the promoted index for the master, verify every declared SHA-256, resolve the named run artifact through index.evidence, then apply the selector to that immutable artifact.
evidence_contract.forbidden_resolution: Do not select the newest UTC run or accept an unpromoted capture.

claims.claim: After one KMP MCP process commits a decision and exits, a fresh process can recover that decision and its attached evidence from the same local store.
allowed_copy: End the session. Keep the why.
Fresh process. Same decision. Evidence attached.

evidence.selector: two distinct successful MCP process lifecycles
both lifecycles resolve to the same isolated SQLite store fingerprint
process 1 kmp_write_memory accepted response and process 2 kmp_inspect response for the identical ref
visible process exit, fresh PID and recovered evidence

claims.claim: Two independent local KMP MCP processes can open one SQLite WAL store, and the second can recover a decision committed by the first without export or import.
allowed_copy: Process A writes it. Process B recovers the why.
forbidden_copy: Codex writes it. Claude already knows

evidence.selector: distinct successful Process A and Process B MCP PIDs
both processes resolve to the same isolated SQLite WAL store fingerprint
Process A accepted write and Process B recovery of the identical ref; no export or import calls
visible PROCESS A and PROCESS B identities, PIDs, store fingerprint and recovered evidence

claims.claim: In the deterministic pool-saturation fixture, KMP preserves the traffic-spike hypothesis, the later root-cause decision and a four-relation proof path between verification and the configuration change.
allowed_copy: Delete the wrong turn. Lose the why.

evidence.selector: fixture bootstrap, selection intent and four-hop trace intent with exact MCP wire hashes
browser-observed long-poll revisions for selection and complete audit path
visible fixture label, both user prompts and response-derived proof output
passed=true and real PTY, Chromium, long-poll and OBS checks

claims.claim: ChronoLoom reacts to public semantic view-tool calls through its real long-poll path.

evidence.selector: sanitized real Chromium network observation of the long-poll path
monotonic OBS focus-scene requests matching the captured EDL

global_boundaries: Local-first describes KMP storage; evidence sent to a cloud agent follows that host's policy.
SQLite WAL sharing is local multi-process access to one directory, not cross-machine synchronization.
KMP returns stored evidence; any conversational prose belongs to the agent host.
Codex and Claude may be named only after raw captures prove both real hosts.
No unpublished release, marketplace version or quality-gate result may appear in a CTA.
